verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 at https://workos.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key. That shows WorkOS publishes a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a public URL, alongside llms.txt and docs.md. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the OpenAPI spec, evidence of how much of the API it covers and how it is versioned, independent corroboration beyond the single probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://workos.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
